reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Fantastic airline boasting a unique fleet of aircraft, staff always go above and beyond to ensure a pleasant experience.
reviews.author: Egypt101

reviews.title: Only fly then if you have a couple hours to spare
reviews.text: Every single time my girlfriend has flown this airline they have been late. Every single damn time!!!
reviews.author: Tim

reviews.title: Scamming Passengers
reviews.text: Flew internationally from the UK with CemAir providing the domestic legs of the travel. On the returnleg from Kimberley to Johannesburg to connect with my international flight, CemAir changed the flight number and bumped me off the new flights' passenger manifest. So the only way to get back to Johannesburg and back to the UK was to buy another ticket. You can see how this CemAir can expolit / abused this position. CemAir can easily scam people especially international travelers who will be forced to buy a new ticket to get home........ Be very careful with CemAir, no one wants to take reasonability and CemAir have interest in responding to my claims never mind a refund.
reviews.author: Quinn

reviews.title: Scary -or inconvenient
reviews.text: It is such a shame that Cemair is constantly battling with an old fleet that one feels is bound together with binders twine. The kind and attentive staff and their booking systems are excellent. It just feels like it is only a matter of time till they suffer an accident. I have been affected by cancellations or delays on so many of the many flights I have booked for myself or my family due to maintenance issues. They are always polite and sweet but it is either scary or inconvenient. Please make the commitment and replace the 36 year old plane before inconvenience turns to disaster.
reviews.author: Glutton22

reviews.title: Damaged luggage
reviews.text: Our flight was over an hour late, on arrival in Durban our suitcases had been damaged. I have emailed Cemair 3 times and have not had any response. The plane feels old as if it’s about to fall apart. Return trip from Durban to Johannesburg was over an hour late again, landing in Johannesburg was terrible. I certainly not recommmed this airline
reviews.author: Lyn P

reviews.title: Mr
reviews.text: This was the best and most amazing experience, flying with my kids for their first time we all enjoyed the flight… The service from the checkin to onboard it’s all super 👌🏽🔥🔥🔥
reviews.author: Alex B

reviews.title: Top service from booking agent to hostess
reviews.text: First time flying with them, I must say, I was highly impressed with the overall service. From the booking agent @Nikiita to the check in @Lauren and @cheslin who were all so very helpful in assisting my sister and I with and making things so effortless and comfortable for us. Tiffany the airhostess so just as amazing. Snacks and drinks are plentyfull. Only bad or one thing I can point out is there seats are old and worn out. Not even that will stop me from flying with them again. Keep it up @flycemair
reviews.author: irfaanmookrey

reviews.title: Worst Airline. Constant Delays. Technical Issues. No communication. Do not recommend.
reviews.text: I flew with CemAir from Cape Town to Joburg. The flight was meant to depart at 06.00am. By 06.00am no one had boarded and there was no communication from the staff. We had to approach someone to find out that there was a technical issue which delayed our flight by three hours. I am now attempting to fly from Joburg to Cape Town and am experiencing a similar issue. The flight is yet again delayed due to technical issues. I will never fly with CemAir again. Not only do they change flight times without informing anyone - they also appear to have reoccurring technical issues which is very concerning. I would suggest you avoid this airline at all costs.
reviews.author: Kriska L

reviews.title: 4 HOUR DELAY and Leaks
reviews.text: The scariest experience of my life. flight was DELAYED for FOUR HOURS!!!! No stuff came to inform passengers. The aircraft was changed to a smaller one and many were left behind..the plane had water leaks dripping on our laps and devices..the worst airline.
reviews.author: Nokwanda

reviews.title: PATHETIC AIRLINE
reviews.text: we flew from durban to cape town and return via Cemair. the aircraft is incredibly small and there is little to no space between seats. you are unable to even stand up at your seat without your head bumping into the overhead carriage. Some taller passengers could not walk through the aisle without their head bent down. we were to return on 11 april on a 5pm flight and received a message on the morning to say it has been delayed till 7pm. we called the call centre to verify the notice and the consultant was not aware of the delay. we travelled with friends who also called and were told that there is a chance the 5pm flight may still leave cape town and the onus was ours to call at 3 to check. we were not in a position to extend our stay at the hotel and had to check out and wait around with our bags for longer than expected and with uncertainty of our departure time. another phone call confirmed that the flight will depart at 7.40. We arrived at the airport and the check in host said the flight was leaving at 7. While waiting we were advised that the flight was moved to 7.30. we only departed at 7.45. it was a day full of uncertainty and no remorse or apology from the airline or its employees. after a miserable day, the air hostesses on the flight were rude to passengers and very unpleasant. they should not be working in a profession that requires peoples skills. the airline is short staffed and unequipped. my first and last using CEMAIR.
reviews.author: trishana317

reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text: I had booked a CemAir flight for my return from CT over the Easter break. I checked in the day before and received a boarding pass. That’s when I noticed my flight had changed to a later time, however I was never notified. I arrived at the airport only to be told that I changed my booking, which I hadn’t. Then I was told I didn’t pay for my ticket, that’s why it’s been cancelled, which I had paid for. Thereafter I was told that when my flight was changed I did not confirm that I could be on the next flight. All of this and I have a boarding pass. I literally was told that my only option is to book another flight with another airline as all their flights were full. This is on Easter Monday (peak travel season). The lady at the counter basically said to me she wasn’t there when I did my booking I can call the call center to find out what happened. My recommendation is, even if they are the only flight available- don’t book CemAir.
reviews.author: Mpolai

reviews.title: Bad service
reviews.text: My last 4 flights on Cemair have been delayed, 2 due to technical ussues and no aircon. Never again !
reviews.author: Richard P

reviews.title: Horrible. Will never fly again with them
reviews.text: The worst airline that was chosen. Flight delays upon delays no guest satisfaction offered. Was told that they don't offer meal vouchers or lounge access. Flight delayed for.more than 8 hours. George delayed Cape Town delayed PE delayed.....really......
reviews.author: Ddd

reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text: This is my second time flying a return trip from hoedspruit in 3 weeks using Cemair and without fail, there has been a technical issue and delay with every flight I have taken with them in these 3 weeks. This leaves the passengers feeling uneasy with every flight I've been on. Pure lack of service and updates from all staff involved
reviews.author: Cameron Perry

reviews.title: Not as bad as people said, but I could’ve been lucky
reviews.text: I was shocked while reading reviews for this airline as I stupidly already had tickets booked before reading reviews. I must say that we did not have as bad of an experience as many others have had. The plane did feel a bit small and cramped with not much legroom. The plane also wasn’t really clean and hygienic. There was no source of entertainment but luckily I had downloaded videos that I could watch on my phone, the staff were very friendly and gave us some free meals for testing and review which consisted of a drink, sandwich of choice, packet of chips and an energy bar which all tasted pretty decent and filling. After landing we were quick to grab our luggage and explore the mother city. There are definitely better airlines out there but this wasn’t the worst or as bad as people described it to be. Maybe I might’ve been lucky with my experience, who knows?
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.title: Fantastic experience for pet travel!
reviews.text: My first time flying with CemAir and I have been blown away by my positive experience with them. I booked this flight as CemAir is the only domestic airline in SA that allows in-cabin travel for cats in a cat carrier. After contacting the airline's pet travel manager, Lezil, everything was arranged for us, the pet travel details were added to my booking and all forms were sent to me with instructions on what to do on the day. At check-in, the staff were awesome and walked me through security all the way to the boarding gate so my two 10-week old kittens were never out of my sight. The flight boarded early and left on time and we were looked after by the most fabulous cabin attendants all the way, drinks and snacks served with a smile and laughs and chats. What a great experience, thanks to the entire team for looking after me and my kittens so well!
reviews.author: Mhairi Maskew

reviews.title: A Disastrous Experience That Should Never Be Repeated
reviews.text: Let me start by saying that my recent experience with CemAir airline was nothing short of a nightmare. From the lack of urgency to the unprofessionalism displayed, this airline should be avoided at all costs. Firstly, my flight was delayed due to a fuel issue - a problem that should have been identified and resolved well before the scheduled 6am departure. It seemed like the airline had no clue that they had a flight to catch, and the delay was just the beginning of the chaos. The whole experience was unbearable. The staff showed no empathy, no willingness to help, and no sense of urgency. It was as if they were doing us a favor by letting us board the plane at all. But this disrespect towards customers is apparently common practice for CemAir, as I later found out. As someone who travels frequently, I can say without a doubt that CemAir is the worst airline I have ever flown with. The level of unprofessionalism displayed is unacceptable, and I am left feeling disappointed, frustrated, and angry. I urge anyone considering flying with CemAir to think twice. Save yourself the hassle, frustration, and disappointment by choosing another airline. CemAir should be ashamed of the way they treat their customers and their lack of concern for their reputation.
reviews.author: Sandile

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Second time flying with Cemair and it still managed to disappoint. FLIGHTS DELAYED AGAIN. No explaination and no sense of urgency. Do not recommend
reviews.author: NOmonde

reviews.title: Don't take this airline if you want to be on time
reviews.text: I was on a flight for a business trip on 21 February 2023 and it was just a disaster from the get go. Firstly the Boarding pass looked like an absolute mess when I received it. Then when I arrived at PLZ the flight was delayed, which was fine, these things happen, yet they informed us that the flight would arrive at 19:00, the flight only came at 19:30. Then when we finally got on the plane, the entire aircraft smelt thoroughly unpleasant and the majority of the fans did not work. Then to add the cherry on the cake, somehow, this pilot managed to fly back from PLZ to JHB in 2,5 hours.... the flight in the opposite direction took just over 90mins that same morning with a different airline. and the "Standard Meal" that was included was a tiny bag of Simba Chips and a small drink. Even the people who travel regularly between the two cities were shocked and complained about how long this flight took, with zero communication from any of the crew as to why it was like that. Also, family members who had expected me at the time the airline promised to land, were frantic thinking that there had been a problem and there was no after hours follow-up lines, no emergency customer service. So in summary, don't take this airline if you need to be on time for... anything.
reviews.author: Nic

reviews.title: Most fantastic flight ever
reviews.text: The staff were friendly and very helpful. We got free snacks and drinks. The plane was small but I loved very minute!
reviews.author: Michele Waller

reviews.title: Cemair is a good airline that offers great service, including comfortable seats and great snack.
reviews.text: Cemair has terrific service and amenities, including comfortable seats and great food. This review will look at all of the pros and cons of flying with Cemair. Cemair has good customer service and some of the best flight attendants in the world. Their flight attendants are professional, treat you with great courtesy, and very friendly. Despite all the reviews I saw before flying with them, it was a very smooth great trip to Cape Town.
reviews.author: Walle

reviews.title: Don’t fly CEMAIR
reviews.text: Don’t fly with CEMAIR. It deserves zero stars. We experienced a terrible 12 hour delay on 9th January 2023 travelling from Durban to Cape Town. They are liars and there was a serious lack of communication to the passengers during the ordeal.
reviews.author: Tricia

reviews.title: Find another company to travel with.
reviews.text: We flew with this Airline for the first time on 1st January 2023 and the flight was nearly three hours late in departing. The member of staff who checked us in was very helpful telling us the flight was on time but just as it was time to board she was now at the gate to tell us it would be 10minutes late in departing as it was late in leaving Durban. Ten minutes turned into 2 1/2hours delay and nearly three by the time we actually took off the plane having been sent from Cape Town to pick us up. Now with 9 days to go before our return flight we receive an email to say that flight has been cancelled. Since the holidays are over we suspect not enough passengers to be viable. They have booked us on a later flight which does not give us enough time to catch our return flight to the UK. We have advised them of this in several emails but have heard nothing back. What a shambles!
reviews.author: Fiftyoner

reviews.title: Flight time changed (-4 hours) without notice day before our flight
reviews.text: We (2 adults and 1 year old) had a flight from Johannesburg to George booked for 10 December at 16:30. Our flight from Hoedspruit was due to land into Jo'burg at 13:00, giving us plenty of time to connect to our onward flight to George with CemAir. CemAir changed the time of the flight from 16:30 to 12:30 without telling us. I only saw the change in time when I came to check in - CemAir had failed to notify us of the change in flight time, entirely. I was left with no choice but to completely re-route our trip to Cape Town with CemAir. This caused us significant additional costs in Cape Town (car hire, accomodation) as well as lost costs in George. When I tried to claim compensation, CemAir ignored my emails and calls. When I cc'd in the CEO - Miles into the email chain, I was essentially encouraged to bring litigation against CemAir. They appear to believe that given the modest costs involved, people will not do this. I will. The flight from Hoedspruit to Cape Town was on a very old plane - smoking trays in the arm rest and in the toilets (disgusting and had not been cleaned for some time). The condition of the plane was alarming - rubber sealant on the outside of the windows flapping for the duration of the 2.5 hour flight to Cape Town. Rude, unsafe and unprofessional - avoid at all costs (likely to be significant otherwise).
reviews.author: Kit S

reviews.title: Mechanical break down in mid air - lost international connecting flight
reviews.text: CEMAIR is the worst airline I've ever flown since I starting flying in 1998. They are unprofessional in dealing with customers. However the Cape Town staff is more helpful, professional and attentive. Because of a mecahnical breakdown 5-10 in flight mode, I lost my connecting flight from OR Tambo, with no compensation and NO communication afterwards to solve the matter.
reviews.author: Patty D

reviews.title: BE CAREFUL!
reviews.text: I bought a flight to depart at 14:15 from OR Tambo to arrive in Cape Town at 16:30 for R1474. A couple of hours before the flight when trying to check-in online, I noticed the time had changed to departure of 15:30 and arrival of 18:15. I had NO notification of the change and upon calling CemAir, I got told that they reserve the right to change or cancel flights. This I agree with IF a notification was sent, which it wasn’t. Not only did the times change, but the price of the new flights was R1185 which is R289 cheaper. MONEY CEMAIR PUTS INTO THEIR POCKET. I spoke to Siles Magoro who claimed to be the supervisor. He was not helpful and told me that it was “my word against theirs” with regards to the notification being sent. He told me they can process a refund but there will be a R250 admin fee, to which I replied is unethical as this is not the customers fault. I received all other notifications perfectly when confirming payments and bookings, so how is it possible to not receive the change notification? I have proof of no notifications being sent, I also asked Siles for the recording of the call we had. He is yet to send it to me. CemAir management, if you see this, please get into contact with me, I’ll be more than happy to help sort out your processes. Siles, unfortunately you didn’t handle this correctly.
reviews.author: Lumardt Senekal

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: What a horrible experience. After checking in online we arrived at the airport to be informed that our (booked) flight had been changed to a later / another flight. Upon checking our gmail we noticed that Cemair changed the flight after we checked in online and during the night. After much discussion with ground staff they managed to reinstate us on the original flight.......just to be informed an hour and some minutes before departure that the flight had been delayed "indefinitely". Cemair has very little infrastructure/ resources to really deal with operational issues in an appropriate manner. How they became an IATA member airline is beyound me. There is nothing about this airline that is really acceptable standards. IATA should clearly do their homework before accrediting an airline as an IATA member. I sincerely hope this airline is IOSA certified. Nevertheless a horrible and terrifying experience ( especially for a 87 year old passenger) and we would never ever even think to use Cemair again and for godsake don't accept payment from customers if you are unable to deliver the service.
reviews.author: Burt Meintjes

reviews.title: Very lovely experience
reviews.text: First time using this airline... it was amazing compared to the others... it's a pity people only posy their bad reviews... the flight was cheap, bags were not charged at additional price and airline included complementary freshments at no additional price... thanks for being amazing.
reviews.author: Mayuri R

reviews.title: Unprofessionalism on Cemair flight 810
reviews.text: I listened to a stewardess tell the other stewardess that she was working with her experiences with a prior passanger from Kenya who was traveling with 2 body guards and the demands that they put on her. It was an interesting story, but very unprofessional and the conversation much too loud. I'm pretty sure that the first 10 rows of passengers heard the conversation. The flight took off 20 minutes later than scheduled time of 06:10 hrs so we were hostages listening to this inappropriate conversation.
reviews.author: Yvonne Molotsi

reviews.title: CemAir Flights
reviews.text: We're beyond frustrated with CemAir. Firstly we had a flight scheduled for 25th Dec after our honeymoon and they canceled the flight without any reason and not even 24hours prior to the time. They did not offer to pay any hotel fee or anything for us because of this (this was extra on us because we did not buget for a extra day) Today we were scheduled to fly again and now they are 1 - 2 hours delayed because the aircraft personal was late. This is the mos pathetic company ever! Very disappointed!
reviews.author: Ilze
